verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: piram piaalaa saadhasa(n)g sabadh surat anahadh liv laiee|

en.bdb: Quaffing the cup of love in the holy congregation, the Sikhs of Guru absorb their consciousness in the Word.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਨੀ ਚੰਦ ਚਕੋਰ ਗਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਵਰਸਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: dhiaanee cha(n)dh chakor gat a(n)mirat dhirasaT sirasaT varasaiee|

en.bdb: As the bird chakor meditates on moon to enjoy cool, from their sight also pours the nectar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਨਹਰ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੋਰ ਜਿਉ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਪਾਇਲ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: ghanahar chaatirak mor jiau anahadh dhun sun pail paiee|

en.bdb: Listening to the roar of clouds they dance like rain bird and peacock.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸਿ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪੁਟ ਹੁਇ ਭਵਰੁ ਸਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: charan kaval makara(n)dh ras sukh sa(n)puT hui bhavar samaiee|

en.bdb: To taste the nectar of the lotus feet they turn themselves into the black bee and become one with the storehouse of delight (of the Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੀਨ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਲਿ ਨ ਖੋਜ ਖੁਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: sukh saagar vich meen hoi gurmukh chaal na khoj khujaiee|

en.bdb: The way of the gurmukhs is not known to anybody; similar to fish they live in the ocean of happiness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਪਿਓ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਨਿਝਰ ਝਰਣ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਣ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: apio peean nijhar jharan ajar jaran na alakh lakhaiee|

en.bdb: They drink nectar; from them gush forth the springs of nectar; they assimilate the unbearable but still they do not make them noticed by any one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: veeh ikeeh ula(n)gh kai gursikh gurmukh sukh fal paiee|

en.bdb: Going across all the stages (of three-dimensional nature-prakarti) they attain the fruits of delights.
Wondrous is the Vaheguru whose greatness is grand.
